$description: AUTHORED — presets, the 6th token source. A preset is a NAMED BUNDLE OF REFS into the other registries (fonts/moods/motion/hues) — data composed FROM the generated styling, zero new code per preset. Cross-validated at build: an unknown ref fails the build. block = BLOCK looks (LK3): a text, quote or picture block stores one by id, between its own values and the card's look; text and quote looks expose font, size, ink, colour and (text) movement, picture looks fit, colour and movement — the recorded three-knob exception (2026-10-23) — and a picture look's colour may be "none" (no frame); theme = one-tap slide looks (W4 trays) — CARD presets (LS2b): a slide stores the preset's id and the cascade reads it, never a copy; `for` names the entity, `exposes` its 4–7 knobs (colour always one), `font` is the card's default for its lines (operator ruling 2026-10-21); motion = entrance choices; bleed = two-colour hover washes over a hue pool (V1 Providers control). The editor's Save-as-preset appends here (data in the authored format, never generated output).

theme.label: Neon intro
theme.blurb: Sci-fi opener — ember heat cooling into lagoon, pulse breathing.

theme.label: Glacier stat
theme.blurb: Cold clean numbers — glacier light over violet static.

theme.label: Arcade flash
theme.blurb: 8-bit night — botanical dark riding the jade current.

theme.label: Warm editorial
theme.blurb: Aerospace headline warmth — terracotta into solar flare.

theme.label: Fuchsia signal
theme.blurb: Synthwave broadcast — fuchsia arcing through orchid haze.

block.label: Sci-fi headline
block.blurb: The one big line of an opener.

block.label: Eyebrow
block.blurb: The small line above a title.

block.label: Chrome subtitle
block.blurb: The quieter line under a title.

block.label: Big quote
block.blurb: A calm pull quote — today's default.

block.label: Terminal quote
block.blurb: A quote typed at a terminal.

block.label: Full bleed
block.blurb: A photo or video that fills the slide.

block.label: Evidence
block.blurb: Proof shots, with a highlighted edge.

block.label: Poster still
block.blurb: A still that holds behind words.

motion.label: Calm rise
motion.blurb: Lines rise in, staggered — the default entrance.

motion.label: Soft fade
motion.blurb: No movement, just presence — for dense slides.

motion.label: Bloom in
motion.blurb: A spring-soft bloom — for reveals that deserve drama.

bleed.label: Providers ink
bleed.blurb: Two colours seeping from two origins, ink into paper.

ancestral.label: Primary
ancestral.blurb: Foundational and unarguable: zero radius, saturated pigment applied straight, no atmosphere at all. Bauhaus before anything is added to it.

ancestral.label: Werkstatt
ancestral.blurb: Deep absorbing pigment given weight and a cast shadow — a heavy block sitting on the wall rather than printed into it.

ancestral.label: Vorkurs
ancestral.blurb: The quiet register: fibrous paper at bauhaus's own zero radius, effectively edgeless. What the surrounding page is made of, not what the poster shouts. Rectilinear rather than measured because measured + paper + none on a spacegrotesk lineage resolves BYTE-IDENTICALLY to editorial's Broadsheet — paper names no tone-relative ref, so the tone cannot separate them.

ancestral.label: Chrysler
ancestral.blurb: The native coordinate. Ziggurat steps, deep lacquer, and one hard specular band running across the top-left. Deco at full dress.

ancestral.label: Machine Age
ancestral.blurb: Metal instead of lacquer, right angles instead of steps, and a hard cast shadow. The industrial half of the same decade.

ancestral.label: Salon
ancestral.blurb: Deco with the volume down: flat pigment, measured radius, no atmosphere. Proof the lineage survives without its ornament.

ancestral.label: Vibron
ancestral.blurb: OPERATOR-RULED: brutalist massive plate hard-cast IS Vibron, and `plate` is the material that ruling required. A quiet dark panel whose whole point is RESTRAINT — the plate says nothing so the ONE active control can. What the editor wears.

ancestral.label: Neo
ancestral.blurb: Heavy block, saturated pigment applied straight, hard offset shadow. Loud, honest, fast — the neubrutalist fill.

ancestral.label: Hacker
ancestral.blurb: Cyan ink on a lit edge with a painted halo. Brutalist bones wearing a terminal.

ancestral.label: Retro-OS
ancestral.blurb: Amber phosphor, square corners, scanline texture. The third of the ratified four.

ancestral.label: Grid
ancestral.blurb: Paper, measured radius, hairline rule, nothing else. Swiss is the ancestor that gets quieter the more correct it is.

ancestral.label: Akzidenz
ancestral.blurb: Saturated pigment at zero radius. The poster half of Swiss — still no atmosphere, because Swiss barely permits any.

ancestral.label: Offset
ancestral.blurb: The same pigment with one hard cast shadow, like a mis-registered second pass on press. The most atmosphere Swiss legally allows.

ancestral.label: Hacker
ancestral.blurb: Operator-named for Workbench. Cold cyan ink on a lit edge, restrained radius, glow used as a SPOTLIGHT on the active thing.

ancestral.label: Gloss
ancestral.blurb: Aero at its most itself — translucent fill, generous radius, light from above-left, a painted halo. Optimistic and glassy, with zero blurred pixels.

ancestral.label: Tactile
ancestral.blurb: The opposite register: fully rounded clay pills with a single specular band and no halo at all. What a touch-first surface wears.

ancestral.label: Bacterio
ancestral.blurb: Flat saturated pigment, generous radius, hard cast shadow. Memphis as Sottsass drew it — playful and unbothered.

ancestral.label: Tawaraya
ancestral.blurb: Fully rounded lacquer with a specular band. The glossy, toy-like half of the lineage.

ancestral.label: Carlton
ancestral.blurb: Chamfered steps in quiet paper, lit by a cyan halo. Memphis is the only ancestor legal for both steps and neon.

ancestral.label: Rodchenko
ancestral.blurb: Right angles, unfinished material, one hard diagonal shadow. The agitational poster.

ancestral.label: Agitprop
ancestral.blurb: A heavy block in quiet paper under scanline texture — the printed, reproduced, distributed version of the same message.

ancestral.label: Lissitzky
ancestral.blurb: Chamfered steps in flat pigment with no atmosphere whatsoever. Pure geometry — the Proun register.

ancestral.label: Broadsheet
ancestral.blurb: Paper, measured radius, hairline rule. The body of the page — it must never compete with what is set on it.

ancestral.label: Cover
ancestral.blurb: Deep lacquer with a specular band and a generous radius. The magazine cover, not the column.

ancestral.label: Masthead
ancestral.blurb: Brushed metal at zero radius with a hard cast. The nameplate and the rules that divide the page.

$ancestral_note: THE PRESETS. A preset is a NAMED LEGAL COORDINATE on the matrix — never a hand-authored bundle of colours. `tone` is a DEFAULT the caller may override; only a role pins a tone outright (that stays danger's privilege). Adding one is one object here: build.rs checks the coordinate against the ancestor's own native/allowed/forbidden rulings, so an illegal preset FAILS THE BUILD. docs/design/mocks/_preset-bench.gen.py renders this same array, so the bench and the app cannot disagree.
